description: This file defines an interface and a class for a transactional grain used in Orleans. It includes functionality for setting, adding, retrieving, and deactivating grain state, with fault injection capabilities for testing transaction resilience.

classes.name: IFaultInjectionTransactionTestGrain
classes.description: Interface defining the transactional grain with methods for setting, adding, getting state, and deactivating the grain.

classes.name: SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrain
classes.description: Implementation of a transactional grain managing single state with support for fault injection and deactivation.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the grain's internal state to a new value within a transaction.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified number to the grain's state, with optional fault injection control.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the grain's state.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain, releasing resources and marking it for deactivation.
